kosovo.title: Flag of the Republic of Kosovo

colors.note: A deep blue matching European Union symbolism, signalling Kosovo's European aspirations.
The gold silhouette depicts the geographic outline of Kosovo.
The six stars represent Kosovo's main ethnic groups — Albanians, Serbs, Turks, Gorani, Roma, and Bosniaks.

desc:
- A blue field bearing a gold silhouette of the map of Kosovo, centred slightly toward the hoist
- An arc of six equal white five-pointed stars above the map
- Adopted on 17 February 2008, the day Kosovo declared independence from Serbia
trivia:
- The flag was chosen through an international competition; the winning design is by Muhamer Ibrahimi
- It is one of only a few national flags to depict the country's geographic outline
- Kosovo is a partially recognised state: over 100 UN member states recognise it, but it is not itself a UN member
